messages:
noah (People Ops): FYI were rolling a small handbook update: 'Professional Boundaries & External Communications' + a short compliance micro-course. Need coordination on tracking, manager attestations, and offer/onboarding language. Target launch: 2026-05-04. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/pro-boundaries-tracker :spiral_calendar:
rebecca (Learning): Nice. I'll draft a 10-min microlearning + 4 quizQs (scenario-based). Can we keep it to 10 mins so we don't overload managers?
mike (Legal): Confirmed policy text uploaded to tracker. Includes escalation flow and clarity on social media/customer interactions. Also flagged two examples that require manager-level waivers.
handbook-bot: Handbook v3.3 published: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/professional-boundaries  updated: External comms, Social media, Escalation
tara (HRIS): For tracking: we can create a nightly export of completions and a manager attestation form. What's the attestation cadence?
joah (People Ops): Managers attest once per team after course close date (one-time for this policy). Deadline: 2026-05-18 (two weeks after launch). Tara, can you surface team lists/headcounts to pre-fill the form?
tara (HRIS): Yep. I'll auto-populate team_name and current headcount from HRIS. CSV export path: gs://redwood-hr-exports/pro-boundaries/pro-boundaries-completions-<YYYYMMDD>.csv
james (Eng Manager): Quick Q: remote contractors who only do code review and never talk to customers — do they need the course?
mike (Legal): If they have any possibility of posting externally or interacting with customers, yes. Otherwise hiring manager can note a reduced scope; waiver via manager+legal required.
rebecca (Learning): I'll include a short decision flow in the microlearning and one quizQ on "who must take this course" to reduce confusion.
joah (People Ops): (typo, meant noah) Small ops items: 1) add one-sentence onboarding note: "Complete Professional Boundaries training within 30 days of start." 2) recruiters to add checkbox in ATS. 3) weekly non-completer digest to managers.
rebecca (Learning): Delivery plan: sandbox posted Thu, pilot with 3 managers Friday, wide release Mon. Microlearning includes 4 scenario-based Qs + one short feedback question.
james (Eng Manager): Can managers delegate attestations if they're OOO?
noah (People Ops): Acting managers can attest but must CC the primary manager. We'll capture attestor_email in form.
tara (HRIS): I'll add attestor_email, team_name, attestation_date, total_headcount, completed_count, notes to the Google Form template.
mike (Legal): Also add requirement to log any granted waivers in the tracker with reason and approver.
rebecca (Learning): ETA for course content: Tue EOD. I'll post pilot link in this thread when ready.
noah (People Ops): Final rollout checklist: legal text in tracker (done), microlearning + quiz (rebecca), HRIS form + nightly CSV (tara), recruiters checklist (rebecca/tom), handbook link (handbook-bot already), manager Q&A drop-in Wed 9am PT (mike).
handbook-bot: New handbook annotation by noah (People Ops): added examples and waiver process.
noah (People Ops): I'll send company-wide announcement day before launch and ping managers in the weekly. Flag blockers here. Thanks! :raised_hands:
